name: file-upload
summary: Authenticated upload route: Content-Length and size caps, type from magic bytes (not the client MIME), random server-side name, no path traversal.

env.UPLOAD_DIR: absolute path of a private folder outside public/ (only while saveUpload writes to disk)

adapt: src/lib/auth.ts requireUser(): wire to your auth provider (it returns 401 until you do).
src/lib/upload.ts TYPES and MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: your allowlist and cap. Keep sniff() deciding the type.
src/lib/upload.ts saveUpload(): swap the disk write for a private bucket put; keep the generated key.
Images: re-encode (sharp) to strip EXIF and polyglots before storing.
route.ts: store (key, owner id) in your DB; serve files with signed URLs, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Content-Disposition: attachment for non-images.
Add a per-user rate limit (launch-security P10).
